item.title: Bury Research Group launches at UC Riverside
item.description:
We are excited to officially launch the Bury Research Group in the Department of Mathematics at the University of California, Riverside.

Our group works at the intersection of nonlinear dynamics, data science, and machine learning, with a focus on tipping points and early warning signals in complex systems. Applications span cardiology, ecology, and climate science.

We are actively recruiting motivated PhD students and postdocs — see the Contact page if you are interested in joining.
